dict.string: Notched controls Music and Spotify and reads what's playing when you turn on Now Playing.
Notched listens to the audio that's playing so the visualiser can move with the music.
Notched shows when your headphones and other Bluetooth devices connect.
Notched shows your upcoming events in the island when you turn on Calendar.
Notched shows the progress of your downloads when you turn on Downloads.

Notched reads your Wi-Fi network's name when you turn that on for Network, and later your approximate location for local weather. macOS shares Wi-Fi names only with apps allowed to use Location.
